concurrency_and_state: EffecMn.vEff (EffecMn.cs:5) is mutated via removeElement(this) inside Effect.update() (Effect.cs:489, 543, 555) while EffecMn.update() (EffecMn.cs:90-93) iterates forward with i++, causing the element immediately following a removed effect to be skipped for that tick.

Effect.vEffData, lastEff, newEff, dowloadEff (Effect.cs:110, 116-120) are static MyVector caches; Effect(int id, int x, int y, ...) evicts vEffData entries when lastEff.size() > 20 without checking if active Effect instances in EffecMn.vEff still reference the evicted EffectData.

Effect2.vEffect3, vEffect2, vRemoveEffect2, vEffect2Outside, vAnimateEffect, vEffectFeet (Effect2.cs:5-15) and EffectManager.lowEffects/mid_2Effects/midEffects/hiEffects (EffectManager.cs:5-11) hold global mutable static effect lists; EffectPanel.update() removes itself directly from Effect2.vEffect3 (EffectPanel.cs:85, 96, 106), whereas EffectManager.updateAll() safely iterates backwards and checks isRemove.
FireWorkMn.paint() (FireWorkMn.cs:33-41) calls fw.removeElementAt(i) during forward iteration without decrementing i and still calls firework.paint(g) on the removed item.

Effect_End mutates Char world coordinates (charUse.cx) directly during effect construction (Effect_End.cs:269-283) and during upd_Skill_Destroy (Effect_End.cs:1051-1053), coupling visual effect playback to entity position state.
GamePad.paint() (GamePad.cs:266-269) overwrites xZone/yZone/wZone/hZone every frame, discarding the screen-size-specific zone setup computed in the GamePad constructor (GamePad.cs:53-93).
cross_module_questions: What server opcode and handler respond to Service.gI().getEffData((short)id) called at Effect.cs:178 and 226, and how does Controller populate Effect.vEffData / EffectChar.effTemplates?
Does GameScr iterate Effect2.vEffect3 backwards (like EffectManager) or forwards when calling EffectPanel.update(), given EffectPanel removes itself directly from vEffect3?
How does Char.cx mutation inside Effect_End (lines 269-283, 1051-1053) interact with server position sync or skill range checks?
Are FireWorkEff, FireWorkMn, and Firework still reachable from GameCanvas/GameScr or superseded by Effect_End typeEffect == 3 (End_FireWork)?

findings.impact: NullReferenceException when rendering under-background effects whose EffectData was evicted by lastEff (>20 entries) or failed to load, crashing or failing the paint pass.
findings.root_cause: paintUnderBackground calls getEffDataById(effId).img != null without checking if getEffDataById(effId) is null (unlike paint() at line 346).
findings.title: Unchecked null dereference in Effect.paintUnderBackground

findings.impact: If EffectData.get() returns null, Effect.update() throws NullReferenceException on data.Length - 1, enters the catch block, and prematurely removes the Effect from EffecMn.vEff.
findings.root_cause: The `if (data != null)` block ends at line 480, but `if (t >= data.Length - 1)` at line 481 executes outside that null check.
findings.title: Effect.update dereferences data.Length outside null check

findings.impact: When an Effect removes itself at the end of its lifetime, the next Effect in vEff shifts into index i and skips its update() for that tick.
findings.root_cause: EffecMn.update() iterates vEff with a forward index loop (`for (int i = 0; i < vEff.size(); i++)`) while Effect.update() mutates EffecMn.vEff via removeElement(this) (Effect.cs:489, 543, 555).
findings.title: Forward-loop removal skips next Effect update in EffecMn.update

findings.impact: Throws ArgumentNullException when anim_data[num7] is null (if num7 != 0) or leaves anim_data[0] zero-initialized, breaking boss/effect animations with ID >= 201 that lack negative sentinel markers.
findings.root_cause: When `!flag`, readData allocates `anim_data[0] = new short[num8]` on line 237, but copies into `anim_data[num7]` on line 238 instead of `anim_data[0]`.
findings.title: Array.Copy targets wrong slot anim_data[num7] instead of anim_data[0] in EffectData.readData

findings.impact: Unnecessary GC allocations during EffectData binary parsing and per-frame Effect.update() calls for missing animation states.
findings.root_cause: EffectData.get(int index) allocates `new short[1]` on every call when `anim_data[index] == null` (called from Effect.update() for typeEff == 5). Additionally, readData() builds an unused string `text = text + num9 + ","` in a loop (line 222).
findings.title: Per-frame short[1] allocation in EffectData.get and dead string concat in readData

findings.impact: Potential IndexOutOfRangeException / OverflowException on malformed or large (>=128 images) EffectData payloads.
findings.root_cause: Image count `b` is read as signed `sbyte` via `readByte()` instead of `readUnsignedByte()`, and bounding-box calculation directly indexes `imgInfo[frame[j].idImg[k]]` instead of calling `getImageInfo(...)`.
findings.title: Signed byte count and unvalidated imgInfo indexing in EffectData parsers

findings.impact: High maintenance cost, brittle state handling, and client-side character position desync when costume 1265 or Destroy skill runs.
findings.root_cause: Effect_End is a 1926-line monolith switching across 12+ effect types; its constructor (lines 269-283) and upd_Skill_Destroy (lines 1051-1053) directly mutate `charUse.cx`, altering character world coordinates from visual effect code.
findings.title: Effect_End monolith mutates Char world position directly

findings.impact: Skill-end audio is never played, and setFrameAngle throws IndexOutOfRangeException if `goc > 345` reaches the `num = 24` clamp (e.g., non-normalized angle > 359).
findings.root_cause: In setSoundSkill_END, `int num = -1;` is never assigned before `if (num >= 0)`, leaving SoundMn.playSound unreachable. In setFrameAngle, `num` is clamped to 24 and used to index `mpaintone_Arrow[num]` whose length is 24 (max valid index 23).
findings.title: Dead sound logic in setSoundSkill_END and off-by-one clamp in setFrameAngle

findings.impact: Broken firework trajectory math, zero-sized screen clear in FireWorkEff, skipped/double-painted elements on removal, and GC allocations inside paint().
findings.root_cause: Firework.preDraw and FireWorkEff.animate convert `angle` to radians before calling `Res.cos`/`Res.sin` which expect integer degrees (0..359). FireWorkEff.w and h are never initialized (remain 0). FireWorkEff.paint() calls preDraw()/keyPressed() and allocates `new FireWorkMn(...)` inside paint(). FireWorkMn.paint() removes from `fw` in a forward loop without adjusting index `i`.
findings.title: Broken trigonometry, uninitialized bounds, and update/allocation inside Firework paint loops

findings.impact: Analog joystick loses device-specific touch zone sizing, has a dead zone in the 21-40 degree diagonal sector, and blocks click-to-move across the entire lower screen width.
findings.root_cause: GamePad.paint() unconditionally overwrites xZone/yZone/wZone/hZone every frame (lines 266-269), overriding constructor sizing. Angle branching (lines 159-202) skips angles 21..40. disableClickMove() (line 293) includes `(px >= xZone && px <= GameCanvas.w && py >= yZone && py <= yZone + hZone)` which subsumes the smaller analog zone check.
findings.title: GamePad overwrites zone bounds in paint, misses 21-40 deg angle sector, and over-blocks clicks

findings.impact: Potential IndexOutOfRangeException when server sends negative or out-of-range effect templateId, or when FrameImage(ID) is called with ID outside arrInfoEff bounds.
findings.root_cause: EffectChar constructor indexes `effTemplates[templateId]` with signed `sbyte templateId` without null/bounds checks. FrameImage(int ID) indexes `Effect_End.arrInfoEff[ID]` without bounds checks (`arrInfoEff` length is 29).
findings.title: Unchecked array indexing in EffectChar and FrameImage constructors

findings.impact: Wrong sprite dimensions used when drawing imgFeet3, and redundant initialization / unvalidated OpenURL calls in GameMidlet.
findings.root_cause: EffectFeet.paint() uses `imgFeet1.getWidth(), imgFeet1.getHeight()` even when `!isF` selects `imgFeet3`. GameMidlet.initGame() sets `instance = this` twice and calls `SplashScr.loadImg()/loadSplashScr()` twice; `flatForm` and `platformRequest` are duplicated wrappers calling `Application.OpenURL(url)` without scheme validation.
findings.title: EffectFeet dimension mismatch and duplicate init/URL wrappers in GameMidlet

key_classes.name: DefaultItemOptions
key_classes.responsibility: Static fallback table mapping 247 item option IDs (0..246) to Vietnamese display strings and creating ItemOptionTemplate objects.

key_classes.name: Dialog
key_classes.responsibility: Abstract base class for modal UI dialogs handling soft-key command bars and pointer/key dispatch.

key_classes.name: EffecMn
key_classes.responsibility: Static manager storing active Effect instances in vEff and dispatching layered paint and update calls.

key_classes.name: Effect
key_classes.responsibility: Runtime map/character sprite effect entity managing frame progression, loop counts, data caching (vEffData/lastEff), and rendering.

key_classes.name: Effect2
key_classes.responsibility: Abstract base class holding static MyVector registries for legacy/panel/feet visual effects.

key_classes.name: Effect_End
key_classes.responsibility: Monolithic controller for end-of-match strings, fireworks, rock/ice particles, and multi-stage special skills (Kame x10, Destroy, Mafuba).

key_classes.name: EffectData
key_classes.responsibility: Binary parser and atlas frame renderer for effect and new-boss sprite sheets.

key_classes.name: EffectFeet
key_classes.responsibility: Temporary footprint/wing ground trail effect extending Effect2.

key_classes.name: EffectManager
key_classes.responsibility: Layered MyVector container managing lifecycle and rendering of Effect_End instances across 4 depth buckets.

key_classes.name: EffectPanel
key_classes.responsibility: Server-triggered small-image effect (EffectCharPaint) attached to coordinates, Char, or Mob.

key_classes.name: FireWorkEff
key_classes.responsibility: Legacy standalone firework screen effect driving FireWorkMn/Firework particle bursts.

key_classes.name: FrameImage
key_classes.responsibility: Vertical/grid sprite-sheet frame slicer and drawer backed by Image and Effect_End.arrInfoEff metadata.

key_classes.name: GameMidlet
key_classes.responsibility: Client entry point configuring server IP/PORT, Netty/socket session handlers, RMS defaults, and splash/server-list boot flow.

key_classes.name: GamePad
key_classes.responsibility: On-screen virtual analog joystick translating touch drag vectors into directional keyHold/keyPressed inputs.

module_summary: Client Game1 visual effect subsystems (Effect, EffecMn, EffectData, Effect_End, EffectManager, EffectPanel, EffectFeet, Firework*), shared data/UI primitives (DefaultItemOptions, Dialog, Frame, FrameImage, Friend, EffectChar/Template/Paint/InfoPaint, EPosition), and input/bootstrap controllers (GamePad, GameMidlet). No direct DB/Redis code; network interaction is limited to requesting missing effect data via Service.gI().getEffData and wiring Session_ME/Session_ME2 to Controller.gI(). Several client Zero-GC violations, loop-removal bugs, unchecked array/null accesses, and character-coordinate mutations in effect code were observed.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Requests binary effect data and sprite sheet from server when local /x{zoomLevel}/effectdata/{id}/data file is missing.
